from django.core.cache import cache
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from .models import UserProfileSummary
from .serializers import ProfileSummarySerializer

class CachedProfileSummaryView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        user_id = request.query_params.get('user_id')
        if not user_id:
            user_id = str(request.user.id)
        elif str(user_id) != str(request.user.id) and not request.user.is_staff:
            raise PermissionDenied("You are not allowed to inspect other user profiles.")

        cache_key = f"cached_profile_summary_{user_id}"
        profile_data = cache.get(cache_key)

        if not profile_data:
            profile = UserProfileSummary.objects.get(user_id=user_id)
            profile_data = ProfileSummarySerializer(profile).data
            cache.set(cache_key, profile_data, timeout=3600)

        return Response(profile_data)
